page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number and a heading line "Idem aliter". Then a Latin/German verb table in three blocks: left column of Latin forms (Che io haueri ... Colore haueranno), a brace linking to a middle column of German (Daß ich hätte ... daß sie hätten verloren), and a separate block "Futur. Subjunctiu" with Latin forms, a bracket labelled "Quando" and a bracket labelled "Cum" with German renderings. Then "Infinit. modo temp. praes." with two Latin/German lines, "Futurum." heading with two lines, and a closing word "Essere" at lower right.

page.notes: Brace and bracket labels (Quando, Cum) and the German column alignment are approximate. Several words in the black-letter-like German and the italic Latin are uncertain; the layout of the verb table was reconstructed line by line and may not match the printed positions exactly.
